Name: ESTUS_FLASK_RECOVERY_PARAM_ST
Description: Flask charges restored when an enemy is killed (HPEstusFlaskRecoveryParam for HP flask charges, MPEstusFlaskRecoveryParam for FP flask charges). The enemy's NpcParam Flask Recovery Param ID picks the row in both params and its HP/FP flask lot points give the chance; every player gets the Host column. Retail: only the Scarab and Large Scarab enemies use a row (1003); the other rows are leftover Elden Ring data.

Fields.Name: Host
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored. In NR every player gets this column, whatever their multiplayer role.

Fields.Name: Replacement Rate
Fields.Description: Chance out of 10000 to use the Replacement ID row instead of this one, rolled on each kill (replaced when a 0–10000 roll is at or below this value, so 0 still has a 1 in 10001 chance). Only checked when Replace ID is 0 or more.

Fields.Name: Replace ID
Fields.Description: Row of the same param used instead when the Replacement Rate roll succeeds. Only one replacement is made: the replacement row's own Replace ID is not followed. A missing row keeps this row. -1: none.
